skill_name: Identify and explain any unethical business practices in the given text.
workflow: ABC Company is engaging in unethical business practices by preying on their customers' lack of knowledge with false promises and deceptive pricing. By offering a variety of products at different prices, the company is able to entice customers to purchase the more expensive options under the false premise that they offer better results. This practice is unethical because it exploits consumers who are unaware of the full cost and potential of their purchase.
